mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in the CPI inflation gauge above 5% signals an overheating economy that will prompt aggressive Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of months following a CPI print above 5%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.1 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in nonfarm payrolls above 300k signals a labor market boom that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next month.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a PAYEMS print above 300k, or the signal explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A collapse in industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following an INDPRO collapse below its 12mo MA, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4% and real estate loans surge above $800 billion, it signals an overextended economy that will suffer a growth slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next quarter.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where the trigger fires, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.1 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5% and the housing starts series collapses below 1 million units, it signals a monetary tightening cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where the trigger fires, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% signals a labor market downturn that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next month.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following a UNRATE print above 6%, or the signal explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below its 6-month moving average for two consecutive months, it signals a persistent supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next quarter, especially if the Fed funds rate is above 4%.
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances where the trigger fires, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
